name: Adult Representation Review
location: Online submission; meeting at our studio or by video if selected
requirements: Submit through our official submission form: a current snapshot (no professional headshot needed), a resume if you have one, and any reel or self-tape links. No experience required.
description: Our agents review every adult submission for representation. If it's a fit, we invite you to a meeting with an agent. There is never a fee to be represented.
keywords: representation agent sign signed submit submission get an agent manager review

name: Youth Representation Review
location: Online submission by a parent or guardian; meeting at our studio or by video if selected
requirements: A parent or legal guardian submits through our official submission form and attends every meeting. Simple, recent snapshots are fine - no professional photos needed.
description: Representation review for young performers. Selected families meet with our youth agent to talk about the industry, work permits, and what representation looks like. Never a fee to be represented.
keywords: kids child children teen youth representation submit agent parent

requirements: Bring a printed snapshot and a resume if you have one. Be ready to read a short commercial script. All experience levels and union statuses welcome.
